ns2:course.label: Bioinstrumentation Project
ns2:course.description: Capstone bioinstrumentation design activity developing project solutions appropriate for academic, industrial, or clinical settings, utilizing principles of design, engineering analysis, and functional operation of engineering systems. Focus on concept-design, safety, human-factors, quality, design for requirements, regulatory strategy, and Six-Sigma considerations. Prerequisite: BIOE 571 and BIOE 572. Students enrolled in the Bioinstrumentation major in the Master of Engineering (M.Eng) degree program.
